## Definition of Done

- [ ] Implementation complete (no placeholders disguised as finished work)
- [ ] Types pass (`pnpm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Tests pass (`pnpm run test`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`pnpm run lint`)
- [ ] Error handling exists where errors are actually possible
- [ ] Security considered (see `docs/plan/05-security-and-privacy.md`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (including `docs/plan/03-roadmap.md` if this changes phase status)
- [ ] Existing behavior preserved (existing-project generation stays non-destructive)

## Scope check
